title: coriandrum radians
intro: Coriandrum radians, commonly known as wild fennel or sea parsley, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Europe. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as digestive relief, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coriandrum radians include its use in treating gastrointestinal issues, respiratory problems, and as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Coriandrum radians include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
